status_note: the pin is the merge head of the fork branch claude/project-thread-5hvqry (moeendres-png/mage): the v11 pin 456b0e22 plus three engine changes that make equal seeds replay equal games and the merge of Muse's player-order branch. (1) The tokens of one event are created in the order they were given (CreateTokenEvent/TokenImpl; Wurmcoil Engine's two Wurms, seed 22 pod 004 and seed 6 pod 044; mage#68). (2) Collections over objects without their own hashCode keep insertion or declaration order where they decide something a player sees or the order of zone changes (CreatedTokensEvent, ContinuousEffects, ManaType sets as EnumSet, four cards that move a set of cards together; mage#70). (3) Eighteen cards iterate their players in table or battlefield order instead of HashMap order (Wave of Vitriol, From the Ashes and sixteen more; plan seeds 24, 27 and 30, four formerly unstable pods; mage#69). The v11 pin gave two semantic hashes for the same seed in these pods; with this pin they give one. Pods and seeds that were stable stay on the same hash (46 of 46 precon pods and 36 of 36 real-pod seeds equal to v11). The perf port (0c0132a2ef) stays out of the pin because it changes option text. The engine version stays 1.4.62. The candidate branch claude/xmage-mp-candidate-20260929 is fast-forwarded to the pin with the repin (Owner's go: 2026-10-22 09:42 UTC, E3, and the request of 15:57 UTC to merge mage#68, #69 and #70 and repin). The native maven.yml run on the exact commit is bound under native_qualification; the Lab bridge suite is bound under lab_runtime_qualification when its Actions run is complete; current_boundary keeps its repin-time status REQUALIFICATION_REQUIRED.

donors.head: 537ce62cc1d75486abfcda5e14b94117d0adec83
donors.observation: CreateTokenEvent kept its tokens in a HashMap and TokenImpl.putOntoBattlefieldHelper collected the permanents in a HashSet; tokens carry no hashCode, so the two Wurms of Wurmcoil Engine (deathtouch and lifelink) were made in an order that changed from run to run: seed 22 pod 004 gave two hashes in 16 plain games on v11 (7 and 9), seed 6 pod 044 two hashes in 8 runs.
donors.fix: LinkedHashMap / LinkedHashSet; CreateTokenEventOrderTest (64 fresh events) fails without it; 16 of 16 runs of pod 044 and 17 of 17 plain games of pod 004 give one hash afterwards

donors.head: 4da49dc221679a2b2776df829bbd1c43e0af3bdd
donors.observation: A HashSet or HashMap over objects without their own hashCode (token, permanent, effect, enum constant) iterates in the order of the JVM identity hash; where the iteration decides something a player sees or the order of zone changes, a game with the same seed can diverge.
donors.fix: insertion or declaration order in CreatedTokensEvent, ContinuousEffects (requirement and restriction effects of a permanent, approving objects of an as-though check), ManaType sets of mana abilities as EnumSet, and Consuming Tide, Dreams of Steel and Oil, Legions to Ashes, Teferi Temporal Pilgrim; ManaTypeOrderTest fails with the HashSet it replaces

donors.head: dd71626b390f179cf392acc654470924de5e3b6b
donors.observation: Wave of Vitriol (HashMap<Player,Integer>, key hash from the per-game random player id) and From the Ashes (HashMap<UUID,Integer>) asked the players in an order that changed from game to game; plan seeds 24, 27 and 30 (pods 030, 028, 005 and 036) gave two to four hashes for one seed. Sixteen more cards apply an effect per player or controller through a HashMap or HashSet of UUIDs the same way.
donors.fix: LinkedHashMap / LinkedHashSet in the 18 card files; no card test (evidence: hash stability of the four pods, see local_observed)
